verdict.rationale: Morph is an inference platform serving open-weight chat models through OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible endpoints, so asking about multimodal models is fair. The evidence only documents text chat models, text classifiers (Reflexes), and code tools (Fast Apply, WarpGrep, Compact). The model catalog lists a 'modalities' field, but nothing shows any vision, audio, or image-generation model is actually offered.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform
